headline: Panama eases limits, Yanbu reloads, US dairy exports at record pace
hook: Two constraints eased: Panama restored its 49-ft Neopanamax draft and is adding transit slots, and Saudi crude is loading at Yanbu again. Both come with caveats.
board: Strait of Hormuz leads with 3 signals and 7-day pressure of 43, down from 48. Red Sea & Suez rose to 9 from 6, and Gulf of Aden fell to 1 from 15.
question: With Yanbu at about 2-2.65m bpd against a pre-attack 5.5m bpd, how are you planning October crude liftings from the Red Sea?

items.headline: Panama Canal lifts Neopanamax transits to 10 a day from Oct. 15
items.statLabel: Neopanamax max draft, restored with immediate effect
items.what: The Panama Canal Authority will raise daily Neopanamax-lock transits to 10 from Oct. 15. That lifts total capacity across the Neopanamax and Panamax locks to 33 slots, FreightWaves reports.
items.why: A deeper draft lets ships carry more cargo through the canal. One industry estimate says a 10,000-TEU ship loses about 450 TEUs per foot of draft restriction. Delayed passages hit US East and Gulf Coast port berths, rail and chassis.
facts: The increase is based on present and projected Gatun Lake levels after near-average rainfall.
Earlier drought cuts reduced total daily capacity to as few as 32 ships in mid-September.
Ports named: New York-New Jersey, Norfolk, Savannah, Charleston, Miami, Houston, New Orleans.
items.watch: The Oct. 15 slot increase. The authority says the watershed is still in deficit and only a reservation guarantees a crossing date.

items.headline: Yanbu crude loadings resume after East-West Pipeline restart
items.statLabel: Pipeline throughput per Kpler, vs 7m bpd capacity
items.what: Saudi Arabia has resumed tanker loadings at its Red Sea port of Yanbu, MarineLink and Reuters report. The East-West Pipeline was shut on September 11 after drone attacks that the kingdom blamed on Iraqi militias.
items.why: The restart adds to signs of more oil flowing from the Middle East, where the US war with Iran has throttled shipments. Kpler sees 3-4m bpd in the coming days and says a return to the pre-attack ~5.5m bpd could take another month.
facts: TankerTrackers: ESA imagery from Sept 27 shows nearly 10m barrels of crude loading at Yanbu and Al Muajjiz.
Two trade sources estimate Yanbu crude loadings at about 2m bpd since last week.
Pipeline operations resumed last Tuesday, and a refiner loaded a cargo from Yanbu late last week.
items.watch: Aramco's October Yanbu loading schedule, sent to customers on Monday, and whether throughput reaches Kpler's 3-4m bpd in the coming days.

items.headline: US cheese and butterfat exports at record levels, CoBank says
items.statLabel: Percent of US milk output exported, past two years
items.what: CoBank ag economist Abbi Groves told Brownfield that US butterfat and cheese exports have hit records and that 2026 could be another record year for US dairy exports.
items.why: Groves says exports are important because cheese and butterfat are in surplus in the domestic market. The report names no routes, volumes or freight costs.
facts: Groves expects the 2026 export share of US milk production to be closer to 17 percent.
Groves says the current export pace resembles the end of 2025.
She spoke to Brownfield at the World Pork Expo in Madison, Wisconsin, on Tuesday.
items.watch: Full-year 2026 export results for cheese and butterfat, where Groves expects records in both categories.
